confirmed_write_sets.write_boundary_fencing: Production auto_sync invocation is guarded centrally: every registered Python component installs scripts/fenced_file_writer.py when AUTOMATION_WRITE_GUARD=1; the auto_sync audit job sets this at job scope and exports AUTOMATION_REQUIRE_RESOURCE_LEASE=1 only after validating the exact Watchdog task, task lease, and resource proof. The audit hook checks repository-local mutating opens and filesystem mutation events and calls assert_resource_lease_from_environment against the live GitHub task queue, task token, resource proof, and fencing token before the mutation. If a path-specific resource lease is not present, the proof must contain logical/production-pipeline and the active task must be the exact workflow_auto_sync Watchdog dispatch, providing exclusive shared serialization. This evidence covers the guarded production invocation; independent writers in other workflows and non-auto_sync entry points still require separate ownership/lease proof.

scheduler_lock_contract.purpose: Serialize scheduler-mediated production audits and hold the lock through asynchronous workflow verification; the live fencing proof is checked at audit start and immediately before publishing to main.
scheduler_lock_contract.coverage_boundary: Scheduler-mediated production workflow and independently scheduled source assessor share logical/production-pipeline. Assessor also fences each logical output and every JSON document-store mutation. Other future independent Python writers must declare compatible contracts before enablement.
